name: Helena
message: 「The reason I had you members of the Crusaders gather here today is none other than this」
Though really, I was just eating breakfast with Nanaka when we got called in by phone.

name: Helena
message: 「I would like to ask you to escort a certain VIP」

name: Helena
message: 「Go without hesitation. Once you go, you'll understand」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Escort duty's a piece of cake, piece of cake! Let's get it over with quick!」

name: Nanaka
message: 「No way am I escorting Miss Bubuzuke!」

name: Synn
message: 「This achievement might be what finally gets the Sweets Society promoted to an official club, you know!」

name: Ria
message: 「It's not much in return, but... we'll help you study for your tests」

name: Synn
message: 「Oh, that's pretty lucky! Come on, Nanaka! If you get a failing grade, your allowance gets cut, right?」

name: Misasagi
message: 「Nanaka-han sure is a tsundere, isn't she」

name: Synn
message: 「Still, to need an escort like this... As expected of a conglomerate heiress」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Even though she's already skilled in self-defense... She's a brute stronger than an average guy!!」

name: Misasagi
message: 「Oh, you don't need to flatter me so much」

name: Ria
message: 「Yeah... Well, about that. If she were only up against ordinary humans, she'd be fine, but...」

name: Synn
message: 「Huh, don't tell me... she's up against Demons?」

name: Ria
message: 「That's right. Apparently, even Demons have been attacking lately...」
Just how big of a deal must she be to get targeted even by demons?

name: Sally
message: 「Nothing personal against Sis Akane herself, mind you, but business is business.」

name: Synn
message: 「Don't tell me you're planning to kidnap her...」

name: Nanaka
message: 「You're gonna owe me big time for this, ya hear?」
